title: Sistema Agroforestal Familiar Integrado y de Seguridad Alimentaria y Nutricional
text: This manual is the result of the experience of technicians and farmers working in the fields of agriculture, forestry, and rural development. The intention was to compile all this experience and put it into a practical, concise, flexible, and easy-to-understand manual with an illustrated summary poster. It is aimed at family farmers interested in improving their farm production, increasing food quality and diversity, and enhancing family food sovereignty. It is part of the project:'Promotion and Establishment of Improved Agroforestry Systems in the Buffer Area of the Central Volcanic Mountain Range of Talamanca', supported by the UNDP Small Grants Program.

title: Fauna del corredor biológico Río Parismina
text: Resultado de un fototrampeo realizado en el 2021 en áreas boscosas del corredor biológico Río Parismina. El material generado busca generar conciencia a las comunidades aledañas acerca de la fauna presente.
